To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we develop efficient video features using information from video compression, we demonstrate accurate action recognition by Fisher vectors and linear SVMs, and we show that the proposed method can be used in real-size applications.

(1) video features extracted from compressed video are highly efficient and achieve state of the art accuracy, (2) Fisher vectors are an effective and efficient way of encoding video features, and (3) fast linear classifiers achieve high accuracy for action recognition.

we propose a new approach to action recognition that is significantly faster than the current state of the art, while maintaining comparable accuracy, and that this approach is based on efficient video feature extraction using motion information from video compression, Fisher vector encoding and fast linear classifiers.
